items.title: At least 3 killed, 14 injured after under-construction building collapses near Karachi's Baloch Colony
items.description:
KARACHI: At least three people were killed and 14 injured on Wednesday when an under-construction building collapsed in Karachi Administration Housing Society near Baloch Colony, according to police and rescue services officials.
Rescue 1122 spokesperson Hassaan Ul Haseeb Khan told Dawn that a ground-plus-five-storey building with one penthouse was constructed on 600 square yards and it collapsed when over 20 workers were present at the site.

items.title: ‘A new era begins’: Pakistan’s Zeeshan Ali becomes first foreigner to board China's Tiangong space station
items.description:
Pakistan’s Zeeshan Ali on Wednesday became the first foreign astronaut to board China’s Tiangong space station, marking a historic moment for his country’s science ambitions and Beijing’s efforts to extend its space diplomacy.
The Shenzhou-24 space flight’s three-man crew entered Tiangong at 2:35pm (0635 GMT), roughly six hours after they took off from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre in northwest China using a Long March-2F rocket.

items.description:

items.title: Bangladesh ties of 'great importance' to Pakistan, President and PM tell visiting parliament speaker
items.description:
Bangladesh Parliament Speaker Hafizuddin Ahmad on Wednesday met with President Asif Ali Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif in Islamabad, where the Pakistani leaders reaffirmed that Islamabad attached “great importance” to its ties with Dhaka.
The parliament speaker, accompanied by a parliamentary delegation, arrived in the country on Monday on a six-day official visit at the special invitation of National Assembly Speaker Sardar Ayaz Sadiq. This is the first official visit to Pakistan by a speaker of the Bangladesh parliament, according to the PM Office (PMO).
